context: The party is exploring an abandoned chapel to an unknown patron (Jergal’s chapel) when the player finds a soul coin tucked inside. Shadowheart is with the group and has already expressed puzzlement about who the chapel was meant to honor. This discovery follows a string of small hoards and ritual items the party has been uncovering (a spider-covered coin pouch in a crevice, a hidden stash under a loose stone, an old prayer sheet, and a broken Moonlantern), so finding another curious, potentially valuable object fits the ongoing looting/investigation. The coin’s soul-related nature makes it notable and possibly tied to death magic or bargains, which is why the player wonders about its worth.
